premise: Bird is sure his song makes the sun come up, until the morning he oversleeps and the sun rises anyway — and everyone was still waiting for his song to start their day.
inspiration: Chanticleer, the rooster who believes his crowing raises the sun (European folk, Chaucer), turned: the song doesn't move the sun, but it starts everyone's day — and ends Owl's night.
lesson: What you give matters even when it isn't what you thought.

en-US.title: Bird Wakes the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] It was nearly morning. Up on a branch, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Bird was quite sure: {bird:face happy} his song woke up the sun. "I sing, and up it comes!" Down in the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower waited, {flower:live close hold} folded up tight. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl {sfx:hoot} hooted from his branch. [curious] "Are you sure?" {bird:live nod} "Of course," said Bird. "I'll just rest my eyes…" {bird:face sleeping} And he {bird:live sleep hold} fell fast asleep. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Up came the sun anyway. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping out… and stopped. {rabbit:face sad} "Where's the song? I can't start my day without it!" {owl:face sad} [sighs] "And I can't go to sleep without it," said Owl. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Bird woke with a jump. The sun was up without him! {bird:face sad} [sad] "Then what is my song for?" {rabbit:hop x2} "For US!" said Rabbit. {bird:face happy} So Bird {bird:live sing} puffed up his chest and {sfx:birdsong} sang. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Off bounced Rabbit to play. {flower:glow} Flower smiled at the sun. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} And Owl, at last, fell fast asleep. [happily] Good morning, meadow. Goodnight, Owl.

es-ES.title: El pájaro que despertaba al sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] Estaba a punto de amanecer. En una rama, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Pájaro lo tenía clarísimo: {bird:face happy} su canción despertaba al sol. —¡Yo canto, y el sol sale! Abajo, {flower:enter} Flor esperaba {flower:live close hold} bien cerradita. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho {sfx:hoot} ululó desde su rama. [curious] —¿Tú crees? {bird:live nod} —Segurísimo —dijo Pájaro—. Voy a cerrar los ojos un momentito… {bird:face sleeping} Y {bird:live sleep hold} se quedó dormido como un tronco. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Pero el sol salió igual. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {rabbit:enter} Conejo salió dando brincos… y se paró en seco. {rabbit:face sad} —¿Y la canción? ¡Sin canción no puedo empezar el día! {owl:face sad} [sighs] —Y yo sin ella no me puedo dormir —dijo Búho. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Pájaro se despertó de un salto. ¡El sol había salido sin él! {bird:face sad} [sad] —Entonces, ¿para qué sirve mi canción? {rabbit:hop x2} —¡Para NOSOTROS! —dijo Conejo. {bird:face happy} Así que Pájaro {bird:live sing} infló el pecho y {sfx:birdsong} cantó. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Conejo se fue a jugar dando botes. {flower:glow} Flor le sonrió al sol. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} Y Búho, por fin, se quedó dormido. [happily] Buenos días, prado. Buenas noches, Búho.
